deals.title: Cruising the Crossroads
deals.summary: $2.75 wells and $4 domestics during the weekend bar crawl
deals.where: Station 4 (S4) stop of the Crossroads crawl, no cover
deals.evidence:
Cruising the Crossroads
We're back baby! $2.75 wells and $4.00 domestics every Friday and Saturday. Cheat Code Lounge 8:00-8:30pm, Sue Ellen's (no cover) 8:30-9:00pm, JR's Bar & Grill 9:00-9:30pm, TMC 9:30-10:00pm, Station 4 (no cover) 10:00-10:30pm.

notes: The site does not mention 'The Big Top' by name. 3911 Cedar Springs Rd is listed as Station 4 (S4), so the Cruising the Crossroads crawl stop there (10:00-10:30pm, Fri/Sat) was used. The crawl is suspended during special events, and prices are subject to change. Monday Industry Night and Trashy Tuesday drink specials were skipped: they are at TMC (3903 Cedar Springs Rd), and Trashy Tuesday has no listed prices.
